text:
maya: Quick check — running midnight capacity scrub for a weekend promo. Looking at EU/US headroom; need to validate our costed hedge if APAC is unavailable. Short summary: baseline 320 GPUs active global, expected spike +30% for ~3h, tokens/sec baseline ~1.2M, p95 latency target 220ms. Can folks sanity-check numbers?

sam: On it. Where'd you get 320? Last reserved burn showed 300 committed + 40 burst yesterday.

liam: I pulled telemetry — rolling 7d avg active GPUs = 315, peak 360 last Thu. If spike +30% => ~468 GPUs. With reserved/dedicated split we need to ensure burst capacity available or fallback to quantized variants.

maya: Yes — my model assumes we can convert ~80% of requests to q4_0 variants with ~1.6x throughput. Cost calc inline: `gpu_hour_cost_usd = 2.8 (us-east spot avg)`, `reserved_premium = +0.6`. So incremental cost for 4h spike = (468-320)*4*2.8 ≈ $1,703 (spot), or ≈ $2,153 if reserved.

sam: ops-bot: deploy-check? Note: network egress to EU during that midnight window is limited to ~10Gb/s per rack; last time we hit 85% and saw token drops. Any network mitigations?

ops-bot: alert: last-night rack egress saturations correlated with 5% token loss events at 21:14 UTC on 1758900000.

liam: We should plan for regional reroute threshold at 80% egress, and synthetic prefetch to reduce cross-region calls. Also consider prefilling KV caches for top 50 prefixes.

maya: Agreed. Also note preemptible churn risk: spot termination rate projected 4% for that window; in the model I added a 6% safety buffer. If we lose ~4% of GPUs, fallback to lower-latency routing to GA capacity and small degradation to p95 ~260ms.

sam: Can we quantify impact on tokens/sec? If fallback to q4_0 + smaller batch sizes, tokens/sec drops ~18% but latency improves slightly. That combo keeps p95 under 300ms.

liam: Quick patch suggestion: set routing policy: prefer local region reserved until 85% utilization, then spill to neighboring reserved, then fallback to quantized model in same rack. Snippet:

```
routing:
  local_threshold: 0.85
  neighbor_spill: true
  fallback_model: q4_0
  prefetch: top_50
```

maya: Nice. Two asks: 1) @sam can run a 1h smoke test tonight to replay a +35% traffic trace against staging pools? 2) @liam can you run cost sensitivity sweep varying spot price ±30%?

sam: I'll kick off replay at 23:30 UTC. Quick note: set `--no-kv-evict` in the replay to match prod cache state. I'll post logs to the thread and tag @paging if we see widespread errors.

liam: Will run sweep at 02:00 UTC and post a short table of incremental cost vs fallback ratio. Expect worst-case incremental cost +42% if spot unavailable and we absorb on reserved.

maya: Thanks. If either test shows >10% p95 regress, we'll flip canary to throttle incoming non-critical routes. I'll post summary in the morning. :thumbsup:
